ei.title: Carol Williams' Quiz Night Donation Request
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the support of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

questions.passage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our (A)[annual / monthly] quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the (B)[support / criticism] of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be (C)[grateful / indifferent] for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① annual — support — grateful: 원문 일치. 연례(annual) 퀴즈 대회, 지역 사업체의 지원(support), 감사(grateful)한 마음 ←정답
❌ ② monthly(월간의): annual(연례의)의 반의어 방향으로 부적절
❌ ③ criticism(비판): support(지원)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ indifferent(무관심한): grateful(감사하는)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: annual(연례의)↔monthly(월간의), support(지원)↔criticism(비판), grateful(감사하는)↔indifferent(무관심한)

questions.passage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are (A)[hosting / canceling] our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the support of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to (B)[donate / purchase] a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an (C)[advertisement / complaint] for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① hosting — purchase — advertisement: (B) purchase(구매하다)는 donate(기부하다)와 다른 의미
❌ ② canceling — donate — advertisement: (A) canceling(취소하다)은 hosting(개최하다)의 반의어
✅ ③ hosting — donate — advertisement: 원문 일치. 퀴즈 대회를 개최(hosting)하고, 상품권 기부(donate)를 요청하며, 대가로 광고(advertisement)를 게재 ←정답
❌ ④ hosting — donate — complaint: (C) complaint(불만)은 advertisement(광고)와 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: hosting(개최하다)↔canceling(취소하다), donate(기부하다)↔purchase(구매하다), advertisement(광고)↔complaint(불만)

Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your (C)[generosity / selfishness], we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① substitute — valuable — generosity: (A) substitute(대리인)는 president(회장)와 다른 의미
❌ ② president — worthless — generosity: (B) worthless(무가치한)는 valuable(가치 있는)의 반의어
❌ ③ president — valuable — selfishness: (C) selfishness(이기심)는 generosity(관대함)의 반의어
✅ ④ president — valuable — generosity: 원문 일치. 학생회 회장(president), 가치 있는(valuable) 상품과 서비스, 관대함(generosity)에 대한 감사 ←정답
det.tip: president(회장)↔substitute(대리인), valuable(가치 있는)↔worthless(무가치한), generosity(관대함)↔selfishness(이기심)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① hosting(개최하다): 원문 일치. 퀴즈 대회를 개최한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② valuable(가치 있는): 원문 일치. 가치 있는 상품과 서비스를 제공하는 사업체
✅ ③ answer sheets(답안지): 원문 일치. 답안지에 광고를 게재
❌ ④ refuse(거절하다): 원문은 consider(고려하다). 편지를 읽고 요청을 '고려'해 달라는 맥락에서 '거절'은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: consider(고려하다) ↔ refuse(거절하다) — 요청을 '고려'해 달라는 문맥에서 '거절'은 반대

det.analysis:
✅ ① prizes(상품): 원문 일치. 우승 팀에게 상품을 줄 계획
❌ ② ungrateful(감사하지 않는): 원문은 possible(가능한). 행사가 '가능하지 않을 것'이라는 맥락에서 '감사하지 않는'은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ request(요청): 원문 일치. 요청을 고려해 달라는 맥락
✅ ④ forward(앞으로): 원문 일치. look forward to(~을 기대하다)
det.tip: possible(가능한) — 행사가 사업체 지원 없이 '가능하지 않다'는 맥락

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 support의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ① (A) 지탱하다 — (B) 후원하다: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 반대하다 — (B) 지탱하다: (A) support는 반대가 아님
❌ ④ (A) 후원 — (B) 반대하다: (B) support는 반대가 아님
det.tip: support: ① 후원/지원(추상적) ② 지탱하다/떠받치다(물리적). 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: generous(형용사) → generosity(명사): 소유격 your 뒤에 명사가 필요. '당신의 관대함에 대한 대가로'
det.tip: 형용사 → 명사 변환: generous→generosity, curious→curiosity, generous→generosity

overlay.excerptSentences: In exchange for your __________ (generous), we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets.

questions.passage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the __________ of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② support: 원문 일치. 사업체의 '지원' 없이는 행사가 불가능하다는 맥락. 기부 요청과 연결 ←정답
❌ ① competition(경쟁): 사업체 간 경쟁이 아니라 후원을 요청하는 맥락
❌ ③ criticism(비판): 사업체의 비판이 필요하다는 맥락 불일치
❌ ④ regulation(규제): 행사에 규제가 필요하다는 맥락 불일치
det.tip: support(지원/후원): 행사 후원을 요청하는 편지의 핵심 단어

questions.passage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the support of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your __________, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① generosity: 원문 일치. 기부라는 '관대한 행위'에 대한 대가로 광고를 게재한다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② curiosity(호기심): 호기심에 대한 대가로 광고를 한다는 맥락 불일치
❌ ③ authority(권위): 권위에 대한 대가라는 맥락 불일치
❌ ④ publicity(홍보): '홍보에 대한 대가'보다 '관대함에 대한 대가'가 문맥에 적합
det.tip: In exchange for your generosity: 관대함에 대한 대가로. -osity 어미 명사들 구분 필요
